title: One em-dash survives in ai_analysis.error_message, which the jobs poll endpoint returns verbatim
evidence:
<> int.to_string(max_retries)
        <> " attempts. Last error: "
        <> code
        <> " — "
        <> message
---
                  #(
                    "error_message",
                    json.nullable(row.error_message, json.string),
                  ),
---
          // bodies. The `error_message` column keeps the untruncated
          // reason so the full diagnostic tail is preserved on the row.
          let truncated_reason = sentry_client.truncate_message(reason)
detail: This diagnostic reason carries " — " into ai_analysis.error_message via update_analysis_failed, and GET /api/v1/ai/jobs/:id returns that column in its JSON payload. The SPA never renders error_message (zero client/src references), so no landlord reads the dash.
recommended_fix: Triage decision only: if the ruling covers undisplayed API payload fields, change the join to ": "; otherwise it is internal diagnostics per the PR's stated boundary.
